meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Defense Line
meta.description: Fend off the frenzied assault with planned, organized action.

units.rawText: Ops Room, this is Zone G's armed squad.
units.displayText: Ops Room, this is Zone G's armed squad.

spans.text: Ops Room, this is Zone G's armed squad.

units.rawText: Entropics are attacking the Oasis via the gap in the sandbox barrier. We are in need of commands!
units.displayText: Entropics are attacking the Oasis via the gap in the sandbox barrier. We are in need of commands!

spans.text: Entropics are attacking the Oasis via the gap in the sandbox barrier. We are in need of commands!

units.rawText: Magnhilda, how's the condition of your squad?
units.displayText: Magnhilda, how's the condition of your squad?

spans.text: Magnhilda, how's the condition of your squad?

units.rawText: The heavily injured have already retreated with Imhotep. There are not many of us remaining, but we will do everything in our power.
units.displayText: The heavily injured have already retreated with Imhotep. There are not many of us remaining, but we will do everything in our power.

spans.text: The heavily injured have already retreated with Imhotep. There are not many of us remaining, but we will do everything in our power.

units.rawText: So... what are your orders, Persicaria?
units.displayText: So... what are your orders, Persicaria?

spans.text: So... what are your orders, Persicaria?

units.rawText: ...It is as you see. This is the Sandbox Barrier's defense node, a building important for sustaining its function.
units.displayText: ...It is as you see. This is the Sandbox Barrier's defense node, a building important for sustaining its function.

spans.text: ...It is as you see. This is the Sandbox Barrier's defense node, a building important for sustaining its function.

units.rawText: As the Oasis is under attack, the Sandbox Barrier has already been damaged. If we lose this node as well, the Sandbox Barrier will become increasingly difficult to maintain.
units.displayText: As the Oasis is under attack, the Sandbox Barrier has already been damaged. If we lose this node as well, the Sandbox Barrier will become increasingly difficult to maintain.

spans.text: As the Oasis is under attack, the Sandbox Barrier has already been damaged. If we lose this node as well, the Sandbox Barrier will become increasingly difficult to maintain.

units.rawText: And if we lose the barrier, the Oasis will have no defensive options left. <color=orange>We cannot afford to lose this defense node.</color>
units.displayText: And if we lose the barrier, the Oasis will have no defensive options left. We cannot afford to lose this defense node.

spans.text: And if we lose the barrier, the Oasis will have no defensive options left.
We cannot afford to lose this defense node.

units.rawText: I understand. Don't worry, we'll guard it with our lives.
units.displayText: I understand. Don't worry, we'll guard it with our lives.

spans.text: I understand. Don't worry, we'll guard it with our lives.

units.rawText: Additionally, I've received a report about our enemies. Some of these Entropics seem to know that defending this node is a key objective for the Oasis, and they will rush straight at the node under the cover of their allies.
units.displayText: Additionally, I've received a report about our enemies. Some of these Entropics seem to know that defending this node is a key objective for the Oasis, and they will rush straight at the node under the cover of their allies.

spans.text: Additionally, I've received a report about our enemies. Some of these Entropics seem to know that defending this node is a key objective for the Oasis, and they will rush straight at the node under the cover of their allies.

units.rawText: Just like an opportunistic boxer... troublesome, do we have any methods to identify them?
units.displayText: Just like an opportunistic boxer... troublesome, do we have any methods to identify them?

spans.text: Just like an opportunistic boxer... troublesome, do we have any methods to identify them?

units.rawText: I will assist you from range and <color=orange>mark these special enemies for you.</color>
units.displayText: I will assist you from range and mark these special enemies for you.

spans.text: I will assist you from range and
mark these special enemies for you.

units.rawText: Good, we'll know what enemies we need to pay attention to.
units.displayText: Good, we'll know what enemies we need to pay attention to.

spans.text: Good, we'll know what enemies we need to pay attention to.

units.rawText: Magnhilda draws a deep breath.
units.displayText: Magnhilda draws a deep breath.

spans.text: Magnhilda draws a deep breath.

units.rawText: Listen up, all of you. There is no retreat. Behind us lays the Oasis' most important defensive infrastructure. For the sake of our home, we cannot afford to lose it.
units.displayText: Listen up, all of you. There is no retreat. Behind us lays the Oasis' most important defensive infrastructure. For the sake of our home, we cannot afford to lose it.

spans.text: Listen up, all of you. There is no retreat. Behind us lays the Oasis' most important defensive infrastructure. For the sake of our home, we cannot afford to lose it.

units.rawText: So hear me, and hear me well. If you are knocked down, go receive healing and supplies, and get back into the field the moment you can fight again.
units.displayText: So hear me, and hear me well. If you are knocked down, go receive healing and supplies, and get back into the field the moment you can fight again.

spans.text: So hear me, and hear me well. If you are knocked down, go receive healing and supplies, and get back into the field the moment you can fight again.

units.rawText: <color=orange>So long as the node remains, we must return to the battlefield, again and again!</color>
units.displayText: So long as the node remains, we must return to the battlefield, again and again!

spans.text: So long as the node remains, we must return to the battlefield, again and again!

units.rawText: Remember, what we are after here is not a one-hit KO, but a clean cross counter! <color=orange>Defend the node, and we will not fail!</color>
units.displayText: Remember, what we are after here is not a one-hit KO, but a clean cross counter! Defend the node, and we will not fail!

spans.text: Remember, what we are after here is not a one-hit KO, but a clean cross counter!
Defend the node, and we will not fail!

units.rawText: Magnhilda... we're counting on you.
units.displayText: Magnhilda... we're counting on you.

spans.text: Magnhilda... we're counting on you.

units.rawText: <size=36>Command us against this wave of attackers, Persicaria!</size>
units.displayText: Command us against this wave of attackers, Persicaria!

spans.text: Command us against this wave of attackers, Persicaria!
